reports.title: Continues to offer consistent fishing opportunities this fall
reports.text: Bass fishing remains fair as fish continue feeding ahead of winter. Anglers targeting bass should focus on weed lines, submerged structures, and warmer pockets of water using crawdad imitations, Senkos, or inline spinners like Rooster Tails.

reports.title: Fishing opportunities remain available
reports.text: Smallmouth bass fishing has slowed considerably with the cooler temperatures, and unless warmer weather returns, the bass bite is expected to remain slow for the remainder of the season.
